Congratulations Ken Paxton on the resounding victory. 

Next, he will destroy Talarico and become the next US Senator from the state of Texas.

I never repost LSU Football, but this is so awesome, it must be the exception.

Bring it AOC.

See you on game day.


LSU Football Report (@LSUReport)

This is pretty bad ass. The only thing that would make it better is if it was all LSU highlights 😂

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/LSUReport/status/2058916275867279867#m

Harris Co. Ankle Monitor Program Under Fire After Murder Suspects Disappear Before Trial.

This happens too often.

Criminals who do this must be arrested & denied bail.

Anyone removing an ankle monitor must get a mandatory minimum sentence in jail. 

I will add this to must pass legislation. 

texasscorecard.com/local/har…

Today, we honor and remember those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedom. 

Their courage is the foundation of this great nation. 

God bless our fallen heroes, our Gold Star families, and God bless Texas.

This truly is insane.

It is against the law in Texas.

I signed a law banning boys in girls sports.

Female athletes in Texas will never have to share the trophy podium with a male.

They worked hard to succeed in their sport. That must never be eroded by woke ideology.


OutKick (@Outkick)

Another week, more female athletes having to share their podium with a trans athlete.

Female athletes keep getting told to ‘be inclusive’ while sacrificing fairness, opportunities, and titles. Enough.

Vid

Speech from Senior Class President at Texas High School.

Our students increasingly are outspoken about their faith.  

"When you are drowning in an ocean of stress, remember that your Savior walks on water."

Hear the crowd cheers.


Sarah (@texasgirl171717)

Amazing speech from the Senior Class President at Prosper High School. Never be afraid to boldly proclaim that Jesus is King! 👏✝️

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/texasgirl171717/status/2058231807758229631#m

These kids are serial criminals with a callous disregard for life. If they are ever released from jail they will surely harm again.

Austin PD, Travis Co. Sheriff Office & Manor PD did their job. Texas Dept. of Public Safety aided them.

The DA & Court must do their job and keep these criminals behind bars.

katv.com/news/nation-world/a…

The Texas Dept. of Public Safety worked with U.S.  Marshals to arrest one the the 10 Most Wanted Sex Offenders.

He was captured in Mexico and returned to custody.

We track down these criminals wherever we can find them.

cbsaustin.com/news/local/tex…

Anita, thank you for courage and for bravely sharing your story. It was a pleasure to meet you.

Anita’s story is a tragedy, and one shared by far too many families across the country who have suffered first at the hands of violent criminals, and again from the reckless decisions of rogue district attorneys and activist judges.

We will not kowtow to radical, lawless ideologies and we will give Texans more power to hold their local leaders accountable.


Kristina Byington (@ByingtonK)

As a life

James Talarico was absent when it mattered most.

When Texas lawmakers voted on Jocelyn's Law -- named for a 12-year-old Houston girl sexually assaulted and strangled by illegal immigrants -- Talarico was a no-show.

Before that, he voted against the Damon Allen Act -- against bail restrictions for violent sexual offenders. And called illegal immigrants "my constituents."

Jocelyn Nungaray's family deserved better. Texas deserves better.

Talarico can run for U.S. Senate. But he can't run from h

Angela Colmenero is a brilliant lawyer and will make an exemplary federal judge. In her service to Texas, she has been a fierce defender of the constitution and steadfast champion of the rule of law.

I congratulate her on this appointment to the federal bench and thank President Trump for nominating her. Texas is proud of Angela, and she will make an excellent federal judge.

Happy Mother’s Day. 

Today, I celebrate three incredible women. My wonderful wife Cecilia, an amazing mother to our daughter Audrey. My mom. And my mother-in-law.

Join me in recognizing all the moms out there, for all that they do to raise the next generation of Texas leaders.

God Bless our Moms & God Bless Texas.

NO!!!

In Texas, the law is clear: 
Only U.S. CITIZENS can vote.


Libs of TikTok (@libsoftiktok)

“Yes or no, should noncitizens be able to vote?”

Spencer Pratt: No

Karen Bass: It depends

Nithya Raman: It depends

This should tell you everything you need to know.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/libsoftiktok/status/2052217415061139606#m

I directed the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board to issue a Cease & Desist to "TexAM," an unauthorized Islamic educational institution operating illegally in Texas. 

If they refuse to comply, legal action will follow. 

Texas will not allow illegal educational institutions to operate in our state.

More: highered.texas.gov/thecb-iss…

Progress in my legal fight against CAIR.

I declared CAIR a Foreign Terrorist Organization.

They sued to block it.

I demanded CAIR give us its donor list, donee list, and details for Nihad Awad’s travel to 9 countries hosting Islamic terror. 

A federal court granted my request

A city-owned water park in Grand Prairie openly advertised a "MUSLIMS ONLY" event -- closed to the general public.

That's religious discrimination. It's unconstitutional. I signed HB 4211 into law -- banning Muslim only no-go zones in Texas.

The City must cancel the event and commit to never allowing something like it again by May 11th, or lose $530,000 in state grants.

Let this be a lesson to local officials: Facilities funded by ALL taxpayers are not just for a subset of Texans.


Sara Gonz

The Texas Dept. of Public Safety is assisting Carrollton PD with the response.

DPS has Highway Patrol units and CID special agents on scene. 

FBI is also involved.


WFAA (@wfaa)

LATEST UPDATE | A large police presence has been reported near Carrollton's Ktowne Plaza. Police are also on scene at a nearby H Mart. WFAA is working to learn more. Here’s what we know: wfaa.com/article/news/crime/…





— https://nitter.net/wfaa/status/2051721521773576332#m

Welcome home, @Dell.

For over 40 years, Texas has been where @MichaelDell built and innovated. Now, Dell Technologies is bringing its legal home to Texas.

This is what happens when job creators and innovators are welcomed, not punished.

More businesses are sure to follow.

businesswire.com/news/home/2…
Thank you President Trump for your endorsement and for standing strong with Texas. You have our back and Texas will always have yours.
